    def test_session_header_set_to_none_is_not_sent(self):
        s = requests.Session()
        s.headers['Accept-Encoding'] = None
        s.headers['foo'] = None
        r = s.get(httpbin('get'))
        assert 'Accept-Encoding' not in r.request.headers
        assert 'foo' not in r.request.headers
        # A request-level value still overrides the session's None.
        r = s.get(httpbin('get'), headers={'foo': 'bar'})
